objective: Primary-source prior-art check for the minimum source-molecularity order of an explosive endotactic stochastic mass-action reaction network.
status: Xu arXiv:2409.05340v2 (latest version listed at cutoff) explicitly states the minimum remains open. No later primary mathematical source lowering the order-10 full-endotactic explosive example was located in this bounded search. This is not priority clearance.

definitions.molecularity_order: Maximum, over reactions y->y', of the L1 sum of reactant/source stoichiometric coefficients ||y||_1. Source-reported by Xu v2, Section 2, p. 3.
definitions.explosion: Positive probability of infinitely many CTMC jumps in finite time from some initial state. Source-reported by Xu v2, Section 3, p. 4.

sources.title: On the Regulary of Reaction Systems
sources.current_version_check: arXiv record queried 2026-10-08; only v1 (2024-09-09) and v2 (2026-05-09) listed, with v2 current.

local_files.method: pypdf text extraction; page separators retained

exact_spans.claim: Molecularity is ||y||_1 for source y; under mass action this is reaction order, and system order is the maximum.
Definition of explosion for the CTMC.
Every mass-action system of order at most 2 that is endotactic is regular/non-explosive; theorem also covers lower- and strongly-endotactic subclasses.
Explosive strongly endotactic example of order 10; minimal explosive order for endotactic stochastic mass-action systems remains open.
Order-2 non-1-endotactic parameterized explosion near-miss; order-3 strongly-(1,1)-endotactic explosion near-miss.
Cites a seventh-order transient strongly endotactic example, and asks separately about minimum order for transience.
Notes the difference in strong-endotactic conventions for the older asiphonic result.

sources.claim_status: Source-reported unless specifically labeled as source-order reconstruction in report.md.

sources.title: Classification and threshold dynamics of stochastic reaction networks

local_files.method: pypdf text extraction; page separators retained

exact_spans.claim: One-dimensional stoichiometric subspace; both positive and negative reaction directions nonempty; positive integer gcd direction; every species changes in at least one reaction.
Under H2-H5, a one-dimensional endotactic mass-action SRN is non-explosive on each stoichiometric compatibility class; no closed-class requirement is stated for this non-explosion conclusion.

sources.claim_status: Source-reported; application beyond H2-H5 is not claimed.
